purpose: Targeted verification of central caption uncertainties and any below-high-confidence selected-move attribution, never full paid retranscription of an already complete caption track.
estimateBasis: The complete caption source is free. A conservative aggregate allowance of 100 verification minutes covers source checks and at most 48 selected moves. Each specific input must be frozen and its cost reserved before execution; no call may take aggregate attempted audio beyond this bound.
timestampPolicy: Clip offsets remain linked to the original upload; original captions are immutable and verified wording is a separately identified supplement.
